title: board.reads: a read the board makes for the owner's own view (Home), by id. Compile adds `module`.

id.description: the read's slot the board asks for (e.g. calendar_today); unique across modules

connection.description: one of this module's own MCP connections: it serves the tool

tool.description: a read tool of `connection` (never write or destructive, never a write kind's)
